Sorry about the mix-up, that's frustrating. Our policies don't cover wrong-item shipments, so I can't confirm whether you can keep the pothos or when the peperomia would arrive, and I don't want to guess at a timeframe. I can escalate this to a Support Lead to sort out. If you send your order number (it looks like LF- plus six digits), I'll include it.

Pothos isn't pet-safe, though peperomia is. If you have pets, keep the pothos out of their reach until this is resolved.
